prose: In the 2026 election to the 140-seat Kerala Legislative Assembly, the United Democratic Front (UDF) emerged largest with 102 seats, against 35 for the LDF and 3 for the NDA. Turnout was 78.95% of 27,196,936 electors.
By vote share, the UDF polled 46.82% and the LDF 36.32%, with the NDA on 12.83%. A total of 883 candidates contested the 140 seats.
Compared with 2021, the UDF gained 61 seats (from 41 to 102); the LDF moved from 99 to 35. Power changed hands from the LDF.
The closest contest was Manalur, won by PROF C RAVINDRANATH (CPIM) over T N PRATHAPAN (INC) by just 126 votes. The largest margin was P.K KUNHALIKUTTY in Malappuram (85,327 votes).
